reference_question: Summarize the main findings and conclusions of this study.
user_question: Can you summarize the main findings and conclusions of this toxicity study?
answer: This acute toxicity study tested Mapleine (Lorillard no. B75) in male Swiss-Webster mice using intraperitoneal administration. Five groups of mice (6 per group) were given increasing doses from 5000 to 10368 mg/kg, with no deaths occurring at any dose level. The LD50 was determined to be 10,368 mg/kg, and researchers noted that higher doses were impractical. Based on these findings, the study recommended safe doses for human trial inhalation of 80.6, 40.3, or 26.8 mg per cigarette when smoking 1, 2, or 3 cigarettes per hour, respectively.
